input.title: Give the FAQ search field an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale:
The visible text "Search questions" sits in a <label> on line 10, but that label isn't linked to the input. It has no for="faq-search" and doesn't wrap the field, so screen readers announce the search box with no name.

I can only edit the flagged element at offset 432, so I'm adding aria-label="Search questions" to the input. It uses the same words as the visible label, so speech-input users can say what they see.

A better fix in the source would be to add for="faq-search" to the <label> on line 10. That links the label properly, and clicking the label text would then move focus to the field. If you make that change, you can drop the aria-label. Please check this with a screen reader before closing the finding.
